title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and for the letter of 12 September.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.17 (po:4500013023-10) through EUR 5.24 (po:4500013392-10), EUR 5.43 (po:4500013795-10) to EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10) between 2025-10-06 and 2026-09-24. That rise is already in our price.

PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

We attach three packages with a longer commitment of 24 months, which secures your volume and workload. All three are without an index clause, matching your fixed alloy coverage. Would a cheaper variant of the peeled bar be available?

AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 – price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.25 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract and have reduced our price to €5.31 to reflect this extended commitment.
As our fixed alloy coverage only extends until March 2027, we must include an AS-14404 index clause for any 24-month agreement.
Regarding your inquiry, our technical department will contact you shortly to discuss whether a more cost-effective variant of the peeled bar is suitable for your application.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.31 per unit.
From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Price basis 1.4404 bar (part:370010) – revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for the quick revision and for moving to 24 months.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We note your fixed alloy coverage until March 2027. To meet you on the surcharge mechanism, one attached package now includes the AS-14404 clause with a 5 % deadband. The others remain without a clause and with a 24-month commitment, which keeps your volume and planning stable. The 90-day option also removes any cash concern on your side.

Would a walk-through of your calculation, as offered in April, help us settle the base price? What is the earliest start for call-offs under these terms?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner

messages.subject: Part 370010 – revised packages with AS-14404 clause
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and the delivery schedule.

We accept your point on the fixed alloy coverage ending in March 2027. All attached packages therefore include the AS-14404 clause with a 5 % deadband. One package extends the commitment to 36 months, which gives you an additional year of secured volume and workload planning. The 90-day options also remove any financing concern on your side.

What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

Could you also confirm whether the January call-off deadline from your holiday shutdown applies again this year?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – revised packages with AS-14404 clause
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership. We appreciate your acceptance of the AS-14404 index clause, which aligns with our fixed alloy coverage ending in March 2027. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our primary Angebot features a price of €5.29 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 24 months, we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404 at a price of €5.23 per unit.

Regarding your query: Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Please understand that our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C, while our margin and our limits stay internal. Furthermore, our colleagues will confirm the exact dates for the holiday shutdown and the January call-off deadline shortly. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
